claim: La Rei Natura and Il Boscareto Resort & Spa share the address Via Roddino 21, 12050 Serralunga d'Alba (CN).
quote: Via Roddino, 21 – 12050 Serralunga D'Alba (Cn) Italy

claim: La Rei Natura is the only restaurant promoted to 3 Michelin stars in the 2026 Italian guide (the 71st edition); the project reached 3 stars in 26 months.
quote: La Rei Natura è il nuovo tristellato della Guida Michelin 2026

claim: Tota Virginia Antico Podere has 13 rooms (5 Comfort, 5 Superior, 3 Junior Suite) in a restored farmhouse at Località Baudana, Serralunga d'Alba, with a panoramic pool and on-site restaurant.
quote: 13 rooms: 5 Comfort, 5 Superior and 3 Junior Suite, all facing the pool. Most come with a private balcony overlooking the Barolo Hills.

claim: Cascina Galarej is a 4-star wine resort & spa in Serralunga d'Alba with 360° vineyard views, built inside a Villaggio Narrante farmhouse.
quote: panoramic 360° views of the vineyards that produce legendary Barolo wine

claim: Cascina Galarej occupies a renovated 1867 farmhouse; ten rooms (classic/exclusive/suite + two family rooms), interiors decorated with historical relics that belonged to King Victor Emmanuel II.
quote: the renovation of an old farmhouse dating back to 1867 ... designer furnishings embellished with historical relics that belonged to King Victor Emmanuel II

claim: Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore is a 4-star albergo diffuso of 14 rooms in 1930s former winery-worker housing on the Fontanafredda estate; interiors by Poliform, Rubelli, Artemide, Gessi.
quote: Originally built as a residence for winery workers and their families ... 14 elegant and modern rooms ... furniture by Poliform, exquisite fabrics by Rubelli

claim: Foresteria delle Vigne is an 11-room boutique hotel inside Fontanafredda's former plant nursery in Serralunga d'Alba; each room is named after a Fontanafredda wine and overlooks the woods.
quote: Once it was the nursery of the shoots, today it houses 11 rooms ... Each room bears the name of one of the Fontanafredda wines.

claim: Hotel Castello di Sinio is a 9-suite, 5-room hotel in a restored 12th-century castle in Sinio, between the Barolo and Barbaresco zones; opened 2005 by owner-chef Denise Pardini.
quote: 9 Suites and 5 Rooms in a beautifully restored 12th Century Castle

claim: Castello di Sinio was called the Langhe benchmark by Wine Enthusiast on opening (2005); rooms inside the castle tower and former chapel; outdoor panoramic pool, sauna, gym.
quote: set the benchmark for the area when it opened in 2005

claim: Casa di Langa is located at Località Talloria 1, 12050 Cerretto Langhe (CN).
quote: Località Talloria, 1, 12050 Cerretto Langhe (CN)

claim: Casa di Langa is a 39-room eco-sustainable resort on 42 ha of UNESCO-protected Langhe countryside; Castle of Serralunga is 3.9 km / ~10 min away.
quote: It's a full-on resort experience with 39 handsome rooms and suites ... 10-minute ride from Castle of Serralunga d'Alba

claim: Casa di Langa holds Michelin Green, Green Globe and Preferred Hotels certifications; on-site Fàula restaurant and Lelòse Spa with organic treatments.
quote: Michelin Green recognition, Green Globe certification, and Preferred Hotels designation

claim: RÉVA Resort in Monforte d'Alba houses 12 rooms in a former farm renovated and opened in September 2017; its FRE restaurant has held a Michelin star five years running.
quote: FRE Restaurant, which has earned the Michelin Star for five consecutive years

claim: RÉVA spa is built inside the estate's former wine cellars; resort sits ~4 km from Monforte d'Alba town with a 9-hole golf course, outdoor pool, and panoramic indoor pool.
quote: The spa was obtained from the estate's old cellars ... 9-hole golf course

claim: Palás Cerequio is a 9-suite Barolo-cru relais owned by the Michele Chiarlo winery, set inside a restored noble palace between La Morra and Barolo; four suites recall 18th-century Piedmontese palaces, five are minimal contemporary.
quote: 9 suite resort hotel ... four suites dedicated to the Past that recall 18th-century Piedmont noble palace architecture, and seven dedicated to the Future

claim: Palás Cerequio is the first relais dedicated specifically to the Barolo crus, with horizontal and vertical tastings on offer for guests.
quote: first resort dedicated to Barolo crus

claim: Castello di Guarene is a Relais & Châteaux 18th-century castle hotel with 15 individually furnished guestrooms and suites, period furniture, frescoed walls, antique Chinese tapestries, indoor pool carved into the rock.
quote: 15 guestrooms and suites reflect the original character of the property, with golden headboards, heavy drapes, period furniture, fine silk fabrics

claim: Castello di Guarene was the summer residence of the Counts of Roero and was built on the site of a medieval fortress.
quote: former summer residence for the Counts of Roero, built on the site of a medieval fortress

claim: Monforte d'Alba to Sinio is ~9 km / ~12 minutes by car; Serralunga to Sinio is comparable at roughly 10 min.
quote: The driving distance is 6 miles or 9 kilometers, with travel time by car of about 12 minutes.

claim: Serralunga d'Alba to Monforte d'Alba is ~9.6 km / ~7 minutes by taxi.
quote: 6 miles ... 7 minutes

claim: Barolo to Alba by taxi is 14.6 km, estimated €18–23 fare, ~14 min — a useful baseline for Langhe taxi pricing.
quote: Take the taxi from Barolo to Alba taxi 14.6 km ... €18–23 ... 14 minutes

claim: LangheInTaxi (NCC Bellero) covers Alba, Barolo, Barbaresco, Bra and surrounding Langhe villages; phone +39 335 5862890 / taxibellero@gmail.com, hours 06:00–23:00.
quote: Call now ... +39 3355862890 ... taxibellero@gmail.com ... 6:00 AM – 11:00 PM daily

claim: BaroloWineTours offers private luxury car/driver transfers and tours covering Asti, Alba, Barolo, Barbaresco — useful for an after-dinner return ride when local radio taxis are scarce.
quote: Taxi Barolo offers private luxury service and guided tours for one or more person in Langhe

claim: Serralunga d'Alba to Guarene is ~20 km / ~22 min by car — the outer edge of practical taxi range for a Saturday dinner return.
quote: The road distance between Serralunga d'Alba and Guarene is 20.03 km ... The average driving time from Serralunga d'Alba to Guarene is 22 minutes

claim: Villaggio Narrante is the Fontanafredda estate's hospitality cluster in Serralunga d'Alba — Cascina Galarej, Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore, and Foresteria delle Vigne — set inside a UNESCO-listed historic winery village.
quote: Villaggio Narrante at Fontanafredda & Casa di E. Mirafiore
